items.q: Well, just like you’ve played with some of the greatest pianists—Hank Jones and Ray…

ctx.x: Well, just like you’ve played with some of the greatest pianists—Hank Jones and Ray…
And Shirley Horn. She had the, she had the way and she, she only sounded good with these two guys—George Abel, electric bass, Abel… and a drummer, [Washington?].
